verdicts.why: At the farmhouse Laura asks 'Did you bring Auntie Nat?' and Lila runs to Natasha; Clint's family treat her as family.
Rogers, Romanoff and Barton fight Ultron in Seoul and retrieve the synthetic body.
The team, Thor included, hides at Barton's farmhouse, and Thor leaves from there to consult Selvig.
After the Hulk's rampage in Johannesburg the team, Tony included, hides at Barton's farmhouse with his family.

value.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
value.text: Thor seeks out Selvig in England for help understanding his vision, and Selvig goes with him to the Water of Sight.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Selvig helps make sense of his vision.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend Thor turns to for help with his vision.

verdicts.why: Thor finds Selvig after a lecture and asks his help; the fandom biography says Thor took Selvig to the Water of Sight (its summary says Selvig guided him), so 'Selvig leads him' is not clearly what happens; neutral wording fixes it.
Fury arrives in the Helicarrier with Rhodes and sends War Machine into the battle where Tony and the Avengers fight Ultron's army.
Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train the new Avengers: Rhodes, Vision, Sam Wilson and Wanda. A shared team on screen keeps the tie.

value.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
value.text: Hill backs the Avengers at their tower, and when Ultron attacks the team's party, she and Natasha both open fire on his robots.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger Hill backs at the tower. Fights off Ultron's robots at the party.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Backs the Avengers at the tower. Fights off Ultron's robots at the party.

verdicts.why: They share the Avengers' inner circle at the tower, but the film never shows Natasha telling Hill about 'language': Hill says 'Steve, he said a bad language word' and Steve asks 'Did you tell everyone about that?' with no one named; the text is also about Hill and Steve. Restated to what is on screen between Hill and Natasha.
Fury and Hill take the hidden Helicarrier to Sokovia; a sentry crashes onto the bridge, Hill shoots it and Fury destroys it.
Fury comes to the Avengers Compound, tells Romanoff the Quinjet's last known location, and she asks if he knew she and Banner would have feelings for each other.
Romanoff co-leads the new Avengers with Rogers, featuring Wanda, War Machine, Vision and Falcon.
As Stark leaves and Barton retires, Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train new Avengers ('Let's beat 'em into shape').
At the farm, while Fury rallies the team, Romanoff mocks Stark for his failure to save the world.
Fury arrives with the Helicarrier and uses it to carry out Captain America's plan to evacuate Novi Grad's civilians.
At the Barton homestead Fury speaks to Stark in private after Wanda's visions, reminding him he did not invent hate and war but can fight them.
Rogers and Romanoff prepare to train new Avengers including Sam Wilson.
At the party's Mjolnir game Steve slightly budges the hammer and Thor looks worried; both fight in the Battle of Sokovia.
Steve confronts Tony at the farm over Ultron, the Avengers fight among themselves over uploading J.A.R.V.I.S., both fight in Sokovia, and they part at the new base.
After Ultron's first attack Thor grabs Stark by the throat; in Sokovia Stark and Thor overload the machine and shatter the landmass.
At the party Romanoff declines to try lifting Mjolnir ('a question I don't need answered'); both fight Ultron from Johannesburg to Sokovia.
Backlash over the Hulk's destruction sends the team, Banner included, into hiding at Barton's farmhouse.
In this title F.R.I.D.A.Y. only replaces J.A.R.V.I.S. as Tony's AI after he becomes part of Vision; the two never exchange anything, so there is no stage here.
Selvig works with Jane on her stage IV cancer and, on a video call, tells her the treatment is not working: 'Jane, I'm really sorry.'
On Alfheim Thor finds Sif beside Falligar's corpse with her arm severed; she warns Gorr will attack New Asgard next and he takes her back there.
Groot fights on Indigarr with the Guardians, and Thor says his goodbyes to Rocket, Groot, Drax, Nebula and Mantis.
Rocket snaps at Thor: 'You said this would be a relaxing holiday'; later Thor says goodbye to Rocket and the others.
Miek, now Valkyrie's secretary, goes to the New Asgard Docks to see Thor, Valkyrie, Korg and Mighty Thor off on the Aegir. Miek is female per the wiki, so the card pronoun fits.
The Guardians, Drax and Groot among them, fight Habooska's army on Indigarr, then deal with Thor's goats on the Benatar.
On the Benatar Drax says he loves the goats and calms them, while Mantis teams up with Nebula to try to kill them.
Nebula and Drax fight on Indigarr as Guardians; Nebula wants to put the goats down while Drax loves them.
Drax and Quill fight on Indigarr as Guardians and say goodbye to Thor together.
Both fight on Indigarr; on the Benatar the Guardians argue with Thor over the goats, Rocket refusing to check their poop and Drax saying he loves them.
Groot and Nebula fight on Indigarr as Guardians and fly off with the team after saying goodbye to Thor.
Groot and Quill fight on Indigarr as Guardians and leave together after saying goodbye to Thor.
Kraglin keeps watch over the Benatar during the battle, marries Glenda, and surprises the Guardians by introducing her as his wife; he then starts the ship.
